## Setup

```{r}
devtools::load_all("../../..")
library(lomad)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load example data

Favorable setting: high n, low phi, high SNR. Unfavorable setting: low n, low phi, low SNR.

```{r}
fav   <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/smooth_d1-0_n600_snr1-5_phi0-3-series.rds")
unfav <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/smooth_d1-0_n200_snr0-5_phi0-3-series.rds")
```

## Inspect structure

```{r}

# Pull one replicate to prototype
rep1 <- fav[[1]]

h_win <- 5L
n     <- length(fav[[1]]$w)

pool_fav <- lapply(fav, function(rep) {
  t_seq        <- rep$vi
  window_max   <- sapply(t_seq, function(t) {
    idx <- max(1, t - h_win):min(n, t + h_win)
    max(abs(1 - rep$w[idx]))
  })
  data.frame(
    window_max = window_max,
    rejected   = rep$rejected[t_seq]
  )
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

table(pool_fav$rejected)
summary(pool_fav$window_max[pool_fav$rejected])
summary(pool_fav$window_max[!pool_fav$rejected])
```

```{r}
# FDR-like: distribution of window max by rejection status
ggplot(pool_fav, aes(x = window_max, fill = rejected)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Window max |1 - w|", y = "Density",
       title = "Ground truth by classification — favorable setting",
       fill = "Rejected") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Sensitivity-like: P(rejected | max|1-w| > c) as a function of c
c_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)

sens_curve <- sapply(c_grid, function(c) {
  above <- pool_fav$window_max > c
  if (sum(above) == 0) return(NA)
  mean(pool_fav$rejected[above])
})

plot(c_grid, sens_curve, type = "l",
     xlab = "Threshold c", ylab = "P(rejected | max|1-w| > c)",
     main = "Sensitivity curve — favorable setting")
abline(h = 0.05, lty = 2, col = "grey60")
```

```{r}
n_unfav <- length(unfav[[1]]$w)

pool_unfav <- lapply(unfav, function(rep) {
  t_seq      <- rep$vi
  window_max <- sapply(t_seq, function(t) {
    idx <- max(1, t - h_win):min(n_unfav, t + h_win)
    max(abs(1 - rep$w[idx]))
  })
  data.frame(window_max = window_max, rejected = rep$rejected[t_seq])
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

table(pool_unfav$rejected)
```

```{r}
ggplot(pool_unfav, aes(x = window_max, fill = rejected)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Window max |1 - w|", y = "Density",
       title = "Ground truth by classification — unfavorable setting",
       fill = "Rejected") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
c_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)

sens_curve_unfav <- sapply(c_grid, function(c) {
  above <- pool_unfav$window_max > c
  if (sum(above) == 0) return(NA)
  mean(pool_unfav$rejected[above])
})

plot(c_grid, sens_curve_unfav, type = "l",
     xlab = "Threshold c", ylab = "P(rejected | max|1-w| > c)",
     main = "Sensitivity curve — unfavorable setting")
abline(h = 0.05, lty = 2, col = "grey60")
```

```{r}
sens_df <- data.frame(
  c       = rep(c_grid, 2),
  p_reject = c(sens_curve, sens_curve_unfav),
  setting = rep(c("Favorable (n=600, snr=1.5, phi=0.3)",
                  "Unfavorable (n=200, snr=0.5, phi=0.3)"), each = length(c_grid))
)

ggplot(sens_df, aes(x = c, y = p_reject, colour = setting)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")) +
  labs(x = "Threshold c", y = "P(rejected | max|1-w| > c)",
       title = "Sensitivity curves — favorable vs unfavorable",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
null <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/smooth_d0-0_n600_snr1-5_phi0-3-series.rds")

pool_null <- lapply(null, function(rep) {
  t_seq      <- rep$vi
  window_max <- sapply(t_seq, function(t) {
    idx <- max(1, t - h_win):min(n, t + h_win)
    max(abs(1 - rep$w[idx]))
  })
  data.frame(window_max = window_max, rejected = rep$rejected[t_seq])
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

sens_curve_null <- sapply(c_grid, function(c) {
  above <- pool_null$window_max > c
  if (sum(above) == 0) return(NA)
  mean(pool_null$rejected[above])
})

sens_df <- data.frame(
  c        = rep(c_grid, 3),
  p_reject = c(sens_curve, sens_curve_unfav, sens_curve_null),
  setting  = rep(c("Favorable (n=600, snr=1.5, phi=0.3)",
                   "Unfavorable (n=200, snr=0.5, phi=0.3)",
                   "Null (d=0, n=600, snr=1.5, phi=0.3)"), each = length(c_grid))
)

ggplot(sens_df, aes(x = c, y = p_reject, colour = setting)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73")) +
  labs(x = "Threshold c", y = "P(rejected | max|1-w| > c)",
       title = "Sensitivity curves",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
